Definition: from G1537 and G3456; to sneer outright at:--deride.
BiblicalUsage: ekmyktērízō is the word for deride. In Luke 16:14, the text says "and they derided him."
TheologicalSignificance: For me, ekmyktērízō means deride, and I leave it at that.
